itens.titulo: Türkiye, Greece have significant potential for cooperation in all areas: Turkish president
itens.resumo: Aegean, Eastern Mediterranean should become regions of stability, prosperity, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan tells Greek counterpart Konstantinos Tasoulas

itens.resumo_pt: Egeu, Mediterrâneo Oriental deve tornar-se regiões de estabilidade, prosperidade, o presidente Recep Tayyip Erdogan diz grego contrapartida Konstantinos Tasoulas.

itens.titulo: Magnitude 6.2 earthquake strikes Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula
itens.resumo: Quake occurs 44 miles from Kamchatka’s capital, says Russian Academy of Sciences’ Geophysical Service

itens.resumo_pt: O terremoto ocorre a 44 milhas da capital de Kamchatka, diz o Serviço Geofísico da Academia Russa de Ciências.

itens.titulo: Crew safe after armed men leave hijacked cargo ship off Yemen: UK maritime agency
itens.resumo: Vessel heads to its next port of call after armed men seized control southwest of Balhaf

itens.resumo_pt: O navio dirige-se para o seu próximo porto de escala depois de homens armados tomarem o controle a sudoeste de Balhaf.

itens.titulo: Sudanese army takes control of Samsour in Blue Nile state after clashes with RSF, allies
itens.resumo: Military sources say army will continue operations to drive Rapid Support Forces out of southeastern state
itens.titulo_pt: Exército sudanês assume o controle de Samsour no estado do Nilo Azul após confrontos com RSF, aliados
itens.resumo_pt: Fontes militares dizem que o exército continuará as operações para expulsar as Forças de Apoio Rápido do estado sudeste.

itens.titulo: Turkish, Greek presidents' meeting concludes in Istanbul
itens.resumo: Closed-door meeting at Dolmabahce Presidential Office lasts approximately 35 minutes
itens.titulo_pt: Reunião dos presidentes turcos e gregos em Istambul
itens.resumo_pt: A reunião da porta fechada no Gabinete Presidencial de Dolmabahce dura aproximadamente 35 minutos.

itens.titulo: Australian WWE wrestler Bronson Reed dies at 38 following medical complications
itens.resumo: Wrestling company pays tribute to Reed, describing him as 'devoted family man,' 'beloved colleague'

itens.resumo_pt: A empresa de luta livre presta homenagem a Reed, descrevendo-o como "homem de família devotado", "amado colega".

itens.titulo: Child killed, father wounded in landmine blast in northern Syria
itens.resumo: Mine left behind by ousted Assad regime exploded near Hayyan in Aleppo province, broadcaster says
itens.titulo_pt: Criança morta, pai ferido em explosão de minas terrestres no norte da Síria
itens.resumo_pt: A minha deixada para trás pelo regime de Assad deposto explodiu perto de Hayyan, na província de Aleppo.

itens.titulo: India’s Congress youth wing protests outside Meta office, demands end to ‘suppression’ of India’s youth
itens.resumo: Protest follows Indian Youth Congress petition to Delhi High Court alleging its posts on Meta platforms are being made unavailable in India without notice or explanation

itens.titulo: Adviser to Iran’s supreme leader warns Iraq not to become ‘tool of Trump’s policies’
itens.resumo: Mohammad Mokhber urges Baghdad to ‘remain vigilant on border issues’ after Iraq closed 2 unofficial crossings, including one with Iran

itens.resumo_pt: Mohammad Mokhber insta Bagdá a ‘permanecer vigilante sobre as questões fronteiriças’ depois que o Iraque fechou duas passagens não oficiais.

itens.titulo: International tribunal rejects Argentina's bid to halt oil drilling near Falkland Islands
itens.resumo: Tribunal rules 18-3 against Argentina's request for provisional measures in dispute with UK

itens.resumo_pt: O Tribunal rege 18-3 contra o pedido da Argentina de medidas provisórias em litígio com o Reino Unido.

itens.titulo: Somalia intelligence operation kills at least 2 senior terrorist al-Shabaab members
itens.resumo: Terrorists were targeted while planning explosive attacks, extorting local communities, says National Intelligence and Security Agency
itens.titulo_pt: Operação de inteligência da Somália mata pelo menos 2 membros terroristas al-Shabaab
itens.resumo_pt: Os terroristas foram alvo enquanto planejavam ataques explosivos, extorquindo comunidades locais.

itens.titulo: Fighting intensifies between Ethiopian federal forces, Tigrayan troops near Eritrean border
itens.resumo: Renewed clashes come amid growing military tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea

itens.resumo_pt: Os confrontos renovados ocorrem no meio de crescentes tensões militares entre a Etiópia e a Eritreia.

itens.titulo: Armed pirates reportedly board merchant vessel in Gulf of Aden: EU maritime security center
itens.resumo: Crew sheltering in vessel’s secure compartment, no injuries reported; EU naval Operation Atalanta investigating incident
itens.titulo_pt: Piratas armados alegadamente embarcam em navios mercantes no Golfo de Aden: Centro de Segurança Marítima da UE

itens.titulo: Palestinian killed, 5 others wounded in Israel’s ongoing ceasefire violations in Gaza

itens.titulo: Türkiye’s foreign minister urges Muslim world to help shape emerging international order
itens.resumo: ‘If we hesitate and stand still, others will decide our future for us,’ Hakan Fidan says at Al Sharq Forum in Istanbul

itens.titulo: Central African States bloc endorses Rwanda’s withdrawal

itens.titulo: Coalition poised for victory in Australia's Victoria state election

itens.titulo: Turkish naval task group trains Libyan Naval Academy students

itens.titulo: Children take over roles at Turkish museum honoring ancient city of Troy

itens.resumo_pt: No local da famosa Guerra de Tróia, os jovens de 9 a 12 anos assumem papéis, incluindo diretor de museu, oficial de segurança, especialista em restauração, arqueólogo.

itens.titulo: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 3 Houthi ballistic missiles targeting southern Saudi Arabia

itens.titulo: US allocated $81 million to Guantanamo migrant operation that detained just 849 people

itens.titulo: Blast near Afghan middle school kills at least 10, over 100 injured

itens.titulo: Polling opens in Algeria's local elections

itens.titulo: Hackers access delivery records of at least 113,855 South Korean postal customers

itens.titulo: 8 people killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash

itens.titulo: South Korea monitors reports of possible China visit by North Korean leader

itens.titulo: OpenAI files countersuit against Apple in dispute over alleged trade secret theft

itens.titulo: Japanese police arrest US military employee on suspicion of trespassing in Okinawa

itens.titulo: Morning Briefing: Nov. 28, 2026

itens.titulo: US regulator takes control of failing Indiana bank with $5.9B in assets

itens.titulo: Taiwan holds local elections, referendum on nuclear energy

itens.titulo: Doctors Without Borders denounces Israeli strike on Gaza clinic

itens.titulo: Montenegro to compensate victims of wartime camps in Croatia, Bosnia

itens.titulo: Polls open in Australia's Victoria for state elections
itens.resumo: More than 1,000 candidates contest 88 lower-house and 40 upper-house seats as opposition seeks to unseat Labor government
